items.title: Chad’s ICC exit plans raise concerns over Sudan war crimes probes
items.description: Last July, Chad announced plans to withdraw from the International Criminal Court, accusing it of inefficiency and of disproportionately targeting African nations. The decision could complicate future investigations into alleged war crimes linked to the conflict in neighbouring Sudan, particularly as ICC investigators …

items.title: Why is Starlink internet so important on the battlefield in Ukraine?
items.description: It is the "backbone of military communications in Ukraine" that provides vital high-speed internet to forces across the country.

items.description: Houthis attempt to raise the cost of the Yemen war for Saudi Arabia as attacks, fighting intensify.

items.title: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries, officials say, after brief truce
items.description: Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia's Ryazan region early Thursday, hours after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over.

items.title: 'Who can still believe Donald Trump? Certainly not Ukrainians, probably not Russians, and especially not Europeans'
items.description: The latest about-face by the US president toward Moscow shows Europe that it must once again take the lead in seeking to end the war in Ukraine, writes Le Monde columnist Sylvie Kauffmann.

items.title: Climate change and drone attacks exacerbate the humanitarian crisis in war-torn Sudan
items.description: Aid groups warn of an imminent collapse of the health system as fighting continues to displace civilians amid the planting season. The UN has extended an arms embargo, but only for Darfur.

items.title: As Houthi attacks undermine Saudi security, a cautious kingdom recalibrates
items.description: Weekend attacks by Yemen’s Houthi militia have largely cut Saudi Arabia off from the world. The normally cautious kingdom is accepting defensive assistance from its allies as it intensifies strikes against the Houthis.

items.title: Yemen: Houthi siege, cholera outbreak and aid cuts put civilians in the crosshairs
items.description: Yemen’s southwestern city of Taiz is facing a “devastating” humanitarian crisis as escalating tensions are dramatically driving up food prices and causing shortages of supplies, the UN Spokesperson said on Tuesday.

items.title: Russia Pounds Ukraine In Overnight Missile And Drone Attacks
items.description: Russia launched overnight missile and drone attacks across Ukraine, striking Kyiv, Kharkiv, and other regions. At least four people were killed in Kharkiv. The attacks came amid a US-proposed energy cease-fire that Moscow has not confirmed.
